tasks.short: Monitor specialists for form and function.

steps.what: List issues from engineers and interior designers.
Monitor electrical, mechanical, interior and sound specialists.
Decide form and function of the final structures.

tasks.design: Open issues from engineers and interior designers are listed on {PROJECT}. Monitoring electrical, mechanical, interior and sound specialists stays the architect's. Form and function of the final structures are a decision. The issue list does not score a specialist.
tasks.previous_blocker: Specialist work was reviewed when a drawing happened to arrive.
tasks.enabler_now: An open issue can be listed. Whether form and function hold cannot.
tasks.still_hard: A specialist proposal the model cannot test, or a conflict between two of them, stays the monitoring.
tasks.human_edge: The architect can tell which proposal serves the building and which only clears an issue.
tasks.altitude: Seeing open issues takes less chasing. Monitoring the specialists and deciding form stay.

reach.task: See decisions that changed the design
reach.learn: Which specialist issue is still open

evidence.claim: An issue list is a query. Judging form and function is not.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the architect monitors and decides the design. The specialists still own their calculations. No score of a specialist is stored.
Structured input: issue id, specialist role, decision. Producer is the project for the issue and the architect for the decision. A decision does not close an issue the architect has not seen.
Monitoring time stays. The list does not accept a proposal.
unknowns: Do specialists file issues in one place?
Who may override a specialist on form?
research_questions: How often does a specialist drawing arrive after the design was frozen?

already_counted.description: Monitoring the specialists is already the remaining time on that step.

incremental.description: Retire issue views when the design revision changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If issues are not filed in one place, the list is empty and the architect still monitors the drawings. Provisional.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Create three-dimensional and interactive design views.

steps.what: Create three dimensional representations of designs.
Build interactive views in the design software.
Check the view still matches the design.

tasks.design: Creating the three-dimensional representation stays the architect's work on {OPS_SYSTEM}. An interactive view is a camera on that model, not a new picture. The architect checks that the view still matches the design. The view is not marked as a generated image because it is the model itself.
tasks.previous_blocker: Interactive views were rebuilt by hand for each presentation.
tasks.enabler_now: A camera on an existing model can be saved. Creating the representation cannot.
tasks.still_hard: A view that hides a problem, or a model that is not the design, stays the creation and the check.
tasks.human_edge: The architect knows which angle misleads a client.
tasks.altitude: Saving a camera takes less rebuilding. Creating the representation and checking the view stay.

evidence.claim: Saving a camera on a model is a setting. Creating the representation is not.
The source pack says a generated image needs a mark. This view is the model the architect built, not a generated image. Other rules differ.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the architect creates the representation and checks the view. A generated image, if one were used, would be marked and is not this step.
Structured input: model id, camera id. Producer is the architect for the representation. A view with no model id is not saved.
Creation time stays. The camera does not change the design.
unknowns: Does the model support saved cameras?
Who may show a view to a client?
research_questions: How often is a presentation view out of date with the model?

already_counted.description: Creating the representation is already the remaining time on that step.

incremental.description: Retire cameras when the model revision changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If the model cannot save a camera, the view is rebuilt and the creation is unchanged. Provisional.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Plan green building projects that conserve energy.

steps.what: Choose measures that minimize adverse environmental impact.
Draft a plan using only the named measures.

loop.input: measures the architect named for this project
loop.output: a plan that uses only those measures
loop.check: a measure that was not named is discarded
loop.stop: one draft; energy figures are not computed here
loop.why_not_simpler: the design of the construction stays with the architect

steps.what: Design green building projects to conserve energy.
File the plan the architect accepted.

tasks.design: The architect chooses measures that minimize adverse environmental impact. A plan may use only those measures. Designing the green building project so that construction conserves energy stays the architect. Energy figures are not computed in the draft. {PROJECT} files the accepted plan.
tasks.previous_blocker: Green measures were a paragraph added after the plan was drawn.
tasks.enabler_now: A named measure can be repeated in a plan. Whether it belongs on this site cannot.
tasks.still_hard: A measure the site cannot support, or a conservation aim the draft overclaims, stays the design.
tasks.human_edge: The architect knows which measure is real on this site and which is a slogan.
tasks.altitude: Restating named measures takes less rewriting. Choosing them and designing the project stay.

reach.task: Read the filed plan and what was not claimed

evidence.claim: A plan that repeats named measures is a draft. Designing the project is not. Energy figures belong to a separate calculation.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the architect designs the green project. The energy calculation is a different task and is not done by this draft.
Structured input: measure id, project id. Producer is the architect. A measure that was not named is not written into the plan.
Design time stays. The draft does not add a saving.
unknowns: Which measures does this office actually use?
research_questions: How often is a green measure drawn and then found impossible on site?

already_counted.description: Designing the project is already the remaining time on that step.

incremental.description: Retire drafts when the measure list changes.

approvals.approved_version: plan the architect designed for that project

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If no measures are named, the draft is empty and the architect still designs. Provisional.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show the last recorded condition of the structure.
Inspect the condition of the structures.
Record the condition the architect found.

tasks.design: The last recorded condition opens from {PROJECT}. Inspecting the structure stays on site. {DOCS} records only the condition the architect found. The previous record is not copied forward as this inspection.
tasks.previous_blocker: Condition was remembered from the last visit, and the note was a photo with no finding.
tasks.enabler_now: A previous record can be shown. The condition today cannot.
tasks.still_hard: A defect that is hidden, or a structure that is unsafe to enter, stays the inspection.
tasks.human_edge: The architect can tell a stain from a failure.
tasks.altitude: Opening the last record takes less searching. The inspection stays. Nothing is recorded that was not found.

reach.task: Read the condition that was found

evidence.claim: Showing a previous condition record is a query. Inspecting a structure is not.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the architect inspects and records. A structural engineer's assessment is a different task. This record is not a certificate.
Structured input: structure id, element, condition, date. Producer is the architect on site. A record with no finding is refused, and the previous finding is not copied.
Inspection time stays. The file does not invent a defect or a clean bill.
unknowns: Are previous inspections stored by structure?
Who may rely on this note?
research_questions: How often is the same defect described differently on the next visit?

already_counted.description: The inspection is already the remaining time on that step.

incremental.description: Retire draft notes that were not the finding.

approvals.approved_version: condition the architect found on that visit

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If there is no previous record, the inspection is unchanged and only this finding is stored. Provisional.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Specialist monitoring, the three-dimensional representation and the inspection stay in person. A green plan uses only measures the architect named, and it does not compute an energy saving. An interactive view is the model, not a generated picture.
reach: The client sees a form decision, not an untouched issue list.
A condition record is what was found on this visit.
skills_to_grow: Do not accept a specialist proposal just to clear an issue.
Do not claim an energy figure in the green plan.
role.ambitious_version: A green measure that the site cannot support is rejected before the plan is filed, and an inspection does not copy the last finding forward.
